rules.message: The select-all checkbox must not have a name — it would serialize into the bulk POST.
Row checkboxes carry the ids (name="ids" value="…") — that is how the payload travels.
Action buttons are real submit buttons with name/value so the no-JS post carries the action.
Action buttons need name="…" (usually "action") — htmx and native submits both send it.
Bulk buttons must swap innerHTML into the tbody (keep the element the grid observes). (innerHTML is also the htmx default — omitting the attribute is fine; anything else is not)
data-hx-target must point at an element in the document. (warn: fragments may target elements elsewhere on the page)
The form keeps method="post" + action so checking rows and submitting works without JS.
The bar usually shows the selection count ([data-hc-datagrid-count]).
